body_lead: Gandhinagar: Chief minister Bhupendra Patel inaugurated the AI (artificial intelligence) Centre for Excellence at GIFT City in Gandhinagar on Monday. The centre became operational as a result of an MoU signed in June 2024 between the state's science and technology department and Microsoft. The centre will utilise key technologies such as machine learning, cognitive services, and chatbot services. It will roll out successful pilot projects in various fields and conduct training programmes on the use of AI in governance, an official statement said.
